title: The data economy of public proteomics over thirteen years of PRIDE
description: Code and frozen inputs for an analysis of 36,249 public PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025. The offline pipeline reconstructs the analyses, 19 figures and 22 supplementary tables. Code is MIT; author-created data, text and figures are CC BY 4.0. Third-party rights are retained.
